_comment: Independently APPROVED financial requirements for the modern replacement. This is policy INPUT authored/approved by humans (not derived from the oracle, and not the legacy binary's behaviour). The modern service is built from this file; the private oracle independently checks the result (Track B). In production each approval requires a real signer; the entries below represent the POC's recorded policy decisions.
supported_subset: Single-layer per-occurrence excess-of-loss recovery for one currency (USD), settled to the cent, for eligible_loss in [0, 1e12]. Explicitly OUT of scope: aggregate limits, reinstatements, currency conversion, complex claims adjustments, multi-layer towers.

approved_divergences.description: Where the legacy binary overflows a 32-bit cents integer on large eligible losses and silently pays 0.00, the modern service pays the correct recovery (the limit cap). This is an intentional correction of a defect, not a compatibility match.
approved_divergences.approved_by: risk-policy-owner (POC record; production requires a named human signer)

equivalence_disclaimer: No claim of universal equivalence to the legacy binary is made. Verification covers only the tested cases and the supported subset above; results are evidence over the sampled inputs, not a mathematical proof of equivalence or of decompilation.
